name: Face Attendance Today
query:
SELECT
    fa.employee,
    e.employee_name,
    fa.attendance_time,
    fa.device,
    fa.confidence,
    fa.status,
    fa.match_type
FROM `tabFace Attendance` fa
LEFT JOIN `tabEmployee` e ON e.name = fa.employee
WHERE DATE(fa.attendance_time) = CURDATE()
ORDER BY fa.attendance_time;
